reuse.why: shared/schedules.ts already exports getScheduledAmount, which resolves missing, numeric and ranged amounts and is used across the client; the diff ignores it and adds a near-namesake getScheduleAmount.

duplication.why: It collapses three inline midpoint copies, but into a second helper that duplicates getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch.

placement.why: The new helper sits in shared/schedules.ts, the right module, right next to the existing helper it duplicates.

scope.why: Only the amount resolution sites and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: Two helpers with almost identical names now encode different rules (midpoint vs furthest-from-zero), so the client tables, balances and edit hooks keep using the midpoint, and forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts keep their own midpoint copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (used by SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile schedules, useScheduleEdit) is neither changed nor reused; new getScheduleAmount is added instead

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts reproduces getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch under a near-identical name with a different range rule.

one_place.where: The new rule lands in getScheduleAmount for app.ts updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, while getScheduledAmount (client UI), server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still compute the midpoint.
